title: Grandma's Bobby Book
author: RambleBook
blurb: Bobby is 5 years old — brave, silly, and kind all the way through. In this story, Bobby and Grandma fly a cardboard rocket to a moon made of pancakes. A keepsake storybook about Bobby, made for Grandma to keep, to show, and to read aloud.
message: For Grandma — every adventure is better with you in it. Merry Christmas!
makerLine: This is a sample book, made with RambleBook to show how yours will look.
